body:
Tooling improvement; no new kappa.

Complete R420 checker: 2.70x faster. Mutation replay: 3.03x faster. Seven paired runs with identical outputs. 672 frames, 1090 matrices, and original failure controls checked.

Full proof, reproduction commands, source pins, benchmarks, limitations and attribution:

title: Tooling: accelerate cold R420 RREF with pinned PR367 arithmetic
